mapper.sql: SELECT g.id group_id, g.version, g.group_code, g.group_name, g.status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM xsy_customer c WHERE c.customer_group_id = g.id AND c.deleted = FALSE) customer_count FROM xsy_customer_group g
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM xsy_customer_group WHERE id = #{groupId} AND deleted = FALSE FOR UPDATE
